reminder.notes:
# Reminder 2.30.2 - Launcher Icon Monochrome & Dynamic Theme Support

### Features
- Added monochrome adaptive icon layer to `launcher_icon.xml` matching `android:roundIcon` and `android:icon`, ensuring seamless tinting with wallpaper dynamic palettes and dark mode on Android 13-17.

### Bug fixes
- Fixed reminder app keeping legacy icon on devices using circular launchers.

mirrordrive.notes:

cards.notes:

mailkeep.notes:
# Mailkeep 0.4.0 - Auto-organize old emails

### Features
- Auto-organize rules: move emails older than N days from one folder to another, for example Inbox to Archive after 30 days. Quick presets (7 days, 30 days, 90 days, 180 days, 1 year) or a custom number of days.
- Safety switches: keep starred emails in place (on by default), keep unread emails in place, optionally mark as read when moved.
- Optional sender and subject filters so a rule only touches matching emails.
- Live preview shows how many emails a rule would move before you save it.
- Rules run over the whole mailbox on the server (not just loaded emails), automatically when you open Mailkeep (at most every 6 hours per account), or on demand with Run all rules now.
- Found under Settings, Auto-organize, per account.

### Bug fixes
- Age rules are kept separate from per-folder filter rules so they are never applied without their age condition.

routerwarden.notes:
Router Warden 1.1.0 - Smoother updates

### Features
- Update downloads can be paused, resumed from where they stopped, stopped, and retried after a network drop.
- Old update files are deleted automatically after an update installs.

### Bug fixes
- The release signing key is pinned in the repo, so updates built on any machine install over this version.
